title: Colorado LEAP 2026-27: Applications Open Nov 1, 2026
desc: Colorado LEAP takes heating bill applications from November 1, 2026 to April 30, 2027. Who qualifies, how to apply and what else it can unlock.
h1: Colorado Heating Help 2026-27: LEAP Dates and How to Apply
lead: Colorado's Low-income Energy Assistance Program, called LEAP, will start taking applications on November 1, 2026. It helps pay part of a winter energy bill. Here is who can apply, the four ways to apply and the repair and weatherization help you may unlock once you are approved.
cards_heading: What we found for Colorado heating help
cards_intro: Each card names the official page we read on October 21, 2026. Dollar amounts are the state's own; anything it does not publish, we do not show.

cards.title: LEAP heating bill help
cards.note: Helps pay part of your home energy costs. It is not meant to cover your entire heating bill. If approved, the payment normally goes straight to your utility.

cards.title: Heating system repair or replacement
cards.note: LEAP households may also qualify for the Crisis Intervention Program, which helps repair or replace a furnace or woodburning stove.

sections: LEAP runs from November through April. The state says it will start taking applications on November 1, 2026, and you can apply at any time between November 1 and April 30. Apply early in the season. Payments are normally sent to your utility once you are approved, and you also get a notice telling you how much help you qualify for.

You may qualify if you pay home heating costs to a utility or as part of your rent, meet the household income limit for the season, and can show lawful presence in the United States for household members born outside the country. Valid proof includes a naturalization certificate, a Born Abroad certificate, a U.S. passport, a permanent resident card, or refugee or asylee papers. Your household means the people you live with and support financially.

Apply online through Colorado PEAK. Call 1-866-HEAT-HELP (1-866-432-8435) to apply by phone. Download a paper application and mail, email or drop it off at your county LEAP office. Or pick up and drop off a paper form at your county human services office. You do not need an interview. Send everything to the right county LEAP office, or your application can be delayed.

Answer every question. List everyone in your household with Social Security numbers and birth dates. Include proof of income, your latest heating bill, or a recent rent receipt if heat is included in your rent. Add proof of lawful presence where needed and details of any self-employment income. Sign the form.
Why this page has no income table
The state posts its income limits on a separate table that is updated each season. We did not copy it here so you do not see an old number. Use the table on the state page before you apply.

LEAP eases one winter. If your heat costs stay high every year, look at the Colorado rebates for insulation and heat pumps on the pages below. Ask about weatherization when you apply, since approved LEAP households may qualify for it.

If your furnace or woodburning stove breaks in the middle of winter, the Crisis Intervention Program is the part of Colorado's system that can repair or replace it. You do not apply for it on its own: the state says it is something you might qualify for once you are in LEAP. That is a good reason to apply early in the season, before the cold snap, not after.
A note about proof of lawful presence

Colorado asks for proof of lawful presence for household members born outside the country. You list the proof you have, such as a U.S. passport or a permanent resident card. A member who cannot give proof can delay the application, so ask your county LEAP office before you send it in if you are unsure which paper to use.
claim_heading: What to do in Colorado this winter
claim_steps: Open the Colorado LEAP page and check the income table for your household size.
Collect ID, income proof and your latest heating bill.
Apply on or after November 1 through PEAK, by phone or on paper.
Watch for the notice that tells you your benefit amount.
Ask about repair and weatherization help while you are in the program.
faq: When can I apply for Colorado LEAP?
Applications start November 1, 2026, and you can apply any time between November 1 and April 30.
How do I apply for LEAP in Colorado?
Apply online at Colorado PEAK, call 1-866-432-8435, or use a paper application at your county LEAP or human services office. No interview is needed.
Does LEAP pay my whole heating bill?
No. The state says LEAP helps pay part of your energy costs and is not meant to cover the entire bill.
Does LEAP help fix a broken furnace?
LEAP households may also qualify for the Crisis Intervention Program, which helps repair or replace a furnace or woodburning stove.
